svg.title: Ledger
svg.desc: - 2026-10-21: Memory audit. The default daemon had run 67 hours with 49 tabs that agents opened by name, one per task, and never closed: 17.4 GB across 47 WebKit processes and 90% of a CPU core, because a tab closed only with its daemon and a busy Mac never lets the daemon idle. Now a tab rests. After a third of UMBRA_IDLE unused it is hidden, so its timers slow and its animations pause as in a background tab; the next command shows it again and runs once the page reports itself visible. After all of UMBRA_IDLE it closes, and a command that names it says why. The back-forward cache is off: it kept every page a tab left frozen in memory (4 tabs after 6 pages each: 3.4 GB with it, 1.3 GB without). bench/memory.py keeps one agent working while others leave heavy tabs behind. With 10 one-page tabs left, memory once they are left went from 2756 to 331 MB and CPU from 15.3 to 1.9 seconds a minute. With 6 four-page tabs it went from 3863 to 312 MB, and the peak from 4271 to 1825 MB. Command latency is unchanged (bench.py, 20 runs). Results and charts: docs/evaluation/memory. The skill, MCP instructions, llms.txt and docs now tell agents to close their tabs. Measured, not adopted: one shared process pool (about 7 MB less per tab, through a deprecated API).

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
